notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Update Notes - Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

[b]Boss Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the boss could leave the map unexpectedly during gameplay. The boss will now stay within the battle area as intended.
[b]General Bug Fixes: [/b]Addressed several other minor bugs and glitches to improve overall gameplay stability and performance.
[b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] Optimized various elements for a smoother gaming experience across all maps.

We’re always working to improve the game! Thank you for your feedback and support. Keep clucking on!
